rationale: All three review lenses completed. The UI implementation satisfies the configurable-limit behavior, but the required backend contract is an unverified external dependency and focused tests do not yet cover all configured-limit boundaries and drop interactions.

business_review.item: Default file limit remains 10 for absent or invalid configuration.
business_review.notes: The app-info resolver accepts only positive integers and falls back to 10; focused tests cover absent, string, fractional, zero, negative, and infinite values.

business_review.item: A backend configured with FILE_DATASOURCE_MAX_UPLOAD_COUNT=N exposes N from GET /v1/info.
business_review.notes: The UI consumes the documented optional field, but this UI-only diff cannot implement or verify the external backend InfoResponse change.

business_review.item: The UI uses an advertised positive integer instead of a hard-coded ten-file limit in create and edit flows.
business_review.notes: The startup store, IndexTypeFile, FilesDropzone, and both validation-schema factories consume the resolved maximum.

business_review.item: Absent or invalid API values keep the UI at a 10-file limit.
business_review.notes: The strict resolver result is supplied to selection and validation paths.

business_review.item: Retained and newly selected edit files together cannot exceed the effective limit.
business_review.notes: Dropzone capacity and makeEditingSchema both count retained plus new files.

business_review.item: Create and update remain one multipart request; no batching or extra request is added.
business_review.notes: No submission or transport path changed in the diff.

business_review.item: Regression tests cover dynamic selection, edit capacity, and configured create/edit validation boundaries.
business_review.notes: Tests cover configured input selection, retained capacity, default edit overflow, and configured create success, but not drag-and-drop or configured-limit overflow for both create and edit.

standards_review.notes: 80bb29224 uses the required EPMCDME-13212 commit subject format.
Pre-commit Prettier, ESLint, and tsc checks passed; npm run typecheck also passed.
The Docker-backed Gitleaks secret scan completed with no leaks.

findings.title: Backend contract remains unverified
findings.problem: The approved specification requires the backend to expose FILE_DATASOURCE_MAX_UPLOAD_COUNT through GET /v1/info, but no backend implementation or deployment evidence is available in this UI repository.
findings.impact: The UI will safely fall back to 10 and cannot deliver a configured higher limit until the backend field is available.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the backend change is deployed and identify its validating change or ticket before approving the UI handoff.

findings.title: Dynamic-limit boundary coverage is incomplete
findings.problem: The new tests do not exercise drag-and-drop or dynamic overflow feedback, and they do not prove configured-limit overflow rejection in both create and edit forms.
findings.impact: A future change could break a second selection path or one of the two validation modes without detection.
findings.recommendation: Add focused tests for drag-and-drop/overflow feedback and configured create/edit overflow boundaries before the review check.
